findings.summary: Rick Gerson (Alpha Wave co-founder, Chairman, CIO) has deep Abu Dhabi and US political connections: (1) Close friend of Jared Kushner for over 10 years; UAE officials consider Gerson 'Kushner's guy'. (2) Attended secret Dec 2016 meeting between Trump transition officials (including Kushner) and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Zayed (MBZ) at Four Seasons NYC. (3) Was in Seychelles in Jan 2017 and met with MBZ, during the same period as the Erik Prince-Kirill Dmitriev meeting investigated by Mueller. (4) Came under Mueller investigation scrutiny for these contacts. (5) Board member of Abu Dhabi Catalyst Partners (Mubadala-Alpha Wave JV). His dual role as Tahnoon/MBZ network intermediary and TikTok USDS JV investor is significant for understanding UAE influence on US tech.

findings.summary: Mueller Report: Gerson served as back-channel between Kushner and Kirill Dmitriev (RDIF CEO), co-drafting US-Russia reconciliation plan Dec 2016-Jan 2017
findings.detail: Per Mueller Report Vol. I: UAE national security advisor George Nader introduced Dmitriev to Gerson in late November 2016. In Dec 2016-Jan 2017, Gerson and Dmitriev co-drafted a US-Russia reconciliation proposal which Dmitriev implied was cleared through Putin. On Jan 18, 2017, Gerson gave a copy to Kushner, who passed copies to Bannon and Rex Tillerson. Gerson was reportedly in the Seychelles around the time of the Erik Prince-Dmitriev meeting (Jan 2017). LittleSis confirms a Social relationship between Gerson (entity 49863) and Dmitriev (entity 345191, CEO of RDIF). NBC News reported flight manifest showed Gerson on plane to Seychelles days before Prince meeting.

evidence.evidence_ref: Mueller Report Vol. I; NBC News reporting; LittleSis relationship data
